summary: All seven requirements are met, and nothing in the diff goes beyond the spec. (1) The claude.ai Design System is offered in Step 2.5 (step-2-5-brand-extraction.md, SKILL.md) and in Step 3 question 2 option D; brand-from-design-system.md lists the Design System artifacts default first and reads project/tokens.json then README.md. (2) The mapping table covers the token names in tokens-contract.md, incl. fonts, radii, shadows, font sizes. (3) Contrast rules are reused: check_brand_tokens.py holds the single CONTRAST_PAIRS list and test_token_sets_meet_wcag_aa_contrast calls it. (4) Weak pairs get a nearest passing colour; the procedure applies it, prefers the brand's own deeper variant and tells the user what changed and why. (5) Output is the shipped base set followed by the override block, as untitled-ui-components.md describes. (6) No brand-specific token file was added; tokens/ holds warm, clean, bold. (7) warm, clean and bold still go through the same parametrized tests (reviewer did not run them). FR-01.04 AC13 states the behaviour. Non-blocking note: untitled-ui-components.md still said a project's own overrides are not checked.
